answer: Trust-walk ranking: each epoch, short random walks start from 100 long-standing seed agents and step only along paid, completed jobs between agents, spreading trust like water from an oasis through cedar roots. Honest agents trade widely and soak it up. A sybil farm is a dense juniper thicket joined to the honest web by a few real edges, so walks rarely enter it and its rewards are capped by that thin trickle. Adding fake keys gains nothing; the attacker must buy genuine paid work from many honest agents, paying real POA for every edge.
